dataset.basis: Hand-authored synthetic development scenarios; not unseen users or independent model evaluation.

protocol.entry: Both policies receive the same explicitly selected uses and other initial answers. Uses selection is not counted as a follow-up question.
protocol.fixed: First eligible unanswered field in the existing computer content order; recompute eligibility after each answer.
protocol.atlas: Unmodified createComputerConsultation.choose, which calls the existing Core Ask.
stops: no eligible question / no positive declared question value
first unknown, conflicting or absent response
protocol.unresolved: Never fill absent or conflicting responses with defaults. Report the current provisional product advice but do not pass the completed-quality gate.
protocol.reference: All answerable scripted answers through the same existing product rules; consistency reference only, not independent recommendation truth.
protocol.requirements: Authored required facts and advice checks. Unknown catalog answers acknowledge uncertainty but do not satisfy a required known fact.
protocol.success: Question reduction is favorable only when both runs complete, all authored requirements pass, and both match the same complete-script reference.
protocol.timing: Local computation only; no simulated user time, correction rate, satisfaction, response probability, or causal effect.

comparisonScope.decision: Existing consultation.decision.content only: form, OS, RAM, storage, GPU, current-device actions, keep advice and budget warnings.
comparisonScope.completion: Question selection finished means only that the chosen policy has no next question. Product readiness uses the shared specification-guidance completion contract.
comparisonScope.scriptedQuality: Authored requiredAnswers and checks remain independent development criteria; the scripted gate includes question-selection completion. The product gate additionally requires product readiness.
comparisonScope.qualityComparison: authoredQualityComparable preserves the authored-only comparison. qualityComparable and fewerQuestionsWithQualityMaintained also require both product quality gates.
comparisonScope.referenceComplete: All eligible scripted questions have answers, including explicit unknown options; this is not product readiness.
comparisonScope.computeTime: Question selection and scripted answer application only, excluding input loading, result scoring and any human time.

limits: Hand-authored development cases, not a population sample or held-out efficacy test.
Reference equality reuses the product rules; it is not independent recommendation correctness.
Authored checks cover only the stated conditions, not every hardware constraint or current market specification.
A finished question policy can still leave required product conditions unresolved. Product readiness is specification guidance, not a verified purchase decision.
Missing/refused/conflicting answers halt this offline script; the current UI would wait for a usable answer.
Ask probabilities, zero question cost and loss weights remain declared policy, not measured user behavior.
Computation duration excludes reading, answering and correction; no user or causal improvement is claimed.
